messages:
kevin: Hey team — I lost my physical ID card and need a quick digital copy for a specialist visit tomorrow. How fast can we get a temporary proof of coverage?

sam_people_ops: You can pull the digital card in the benefits portal right now. If you need an official letter, we can request an expedited proof of coverage from Acme. Do you have the member ID?

kevin: Member ID ends 3327. I tried the portal but it errors on my phone. Getting "session expired" repeatedly.

olivia-benefits: Kevin, I'll generate a company proof-of-coverage letter and attach the member's plan summary. That usually suffices at check-in for outpatient visits. Can you share the clinic name and appointment time?

kevin: Clinic: Northside Sports Med, appt 10:30am tomorrow. Thanks.

insurance-bot: Support ticket created: ACME-POC-202605-4420. Request type: expedited member verification letter. Estimated response: 1 business day.

olivia-benefits: Drafting letter now — will include plan name (Redwood PPO Gold), member name and last4, effective dates, and contact line for Acme verification. I'll drop it here as a PDF link once done.

sam_people_ops: If clinic insists on card at check-in, ask them to call Acme Provider Services and verify eligibility using the member name + DOB. That call usually confirms network and coverage immediately.

olivia-benefits: Uploaded proof-of-coverage PDF: https://files.redwood.internal/poc/kevin-3327-202605.pdf — also emailed to Kevin. Note: portal glitch reported to IT.

kevin: Got it, thank you! I'll bring the PDF and ask clinic to call Acme if needed. Portal glitch blocks mobile but web on laptop works for now.

insurance-bot: ACME-POC-202605-4420 closed: expedited letter delivered.

olivia-benefits: Filing note in tracker: "Lost physical ID -> expedited POC issued; portal mobile bug reported." Closing loop.

kevin: Appreciate the quick help! :thumbsup:
